column1: # NWE AI Vocabulary Map
# Maps from input patterns → vocabulary sets → response strategies.
# Used by VocabularyInferrer and VocabularyLink to select appropriate
# language for human-grade responses.
# Format: DOMAIN|REGISTER|VOCABULARY_WORDS (pipe-separated)
# Register: F=formal, C=casual, A=academic, T=technical, W=warm
# All NWE AI modules consume this map at startup.
# Append new entries at the end; do not reorder existing entries.

TECHNOLOGY|T|architecture, implementation, infrastructure, scalable, modular, concurrent, asynchronous, fault-tolerant, distributed, deterministic, idempotent, throughput, latency, bandwidth, protocol, interface, abstraction, encapsulation, polymorphism, inheritance
TECHNOLOGY|C|setup, fix, broken, works, fast, slow, crash, bug, glitch, update, install, reboot, connect, download, upload, stream
TECHNOLOGY|F|specification, configuration, deployment, integration, compliance, certification, provisioning, orchestration, containerization, virtualization
